senses.gloss: ālepana (SITI), anointing; coating the image with unguent.

a-lekhanī-praveśatayā (EI 29), probably refers to the absence of the right to re-grant the gift land to any other party on the part of the king and to alienate the gift land on the part of the donee; lekhanī-praveśa may mean that the gift land should not be made the subject of another document.
